home.heroEyebrow: The Investment Club of IIM Lucknow · Since 2005
home.heroSubtitle: Credence Capital advises the largest and oldest student-run investment fund, managed by IIM Lucknow students since 2005. Partner with us to reach the finance talent behind two decades of hands-on investing.
home.introTitle: Hands-on investment management, not just theory.
home.introBody:
Credence Capital is an investment oriented club that aims to further IIM Lucknow community's knowledge in financial markets, asset markets and personal finance through investment analysis. Founded in 2005, it has been advising the largest and oldest student-run investment fund, which has consistently outperformed the benchmark indices over the last decade.

Each year a small group of fund managers is chosen through a rigorous internal selection process and mentored by senior members. Their strategies span value investing, bottom fishing, arbitrage, mathematical models and technical and fundamental analysis, and they change with every new batch.
home.whyTitle: Why leading firms partner with Credence
home.whyBody: Our partners get more than a logo on a banner. They get steady, measurable engagement with an audience that is hard to reach any other way: student fund managers, finance-focused MBA students, faculty and participants from B-schools across India.
home.ctaBody: Tell us what you want to achieve — hiring, brand visibility, thought leadership or product adoption — and we will design a partnership around it.

about.title: About Credence Capital
about.lead: Credence Capital is the investment club of the Indian Institute of Management Lucknow. Since 2005 it has advised a fund run entirely by students.
about.story:
The fund gives IIM Lucknow students hands-on experience in investment management that builds on what they learn in class and at work. The investment approach combines multiple strategies (value investing, bottom fishing, arbitrage opportunities, mathematical models, and technical and fundamental analysis), and these change with every new batch.

Members are selected through a rigorous internal selection process, and the new fund advisors are mentored and trained by senior club members. The club's work includes advising on investments, industry analysis, publishing newsletters, knowledge-sharing sessions, and stock valuations and recommendations. Faculty are regularly consulted, and the club has worked closely with them since its inception.

The club has gained wide recognition in financial circles, and the fund's record has been covered by Bloomberg Quint, Business Standard, The Hindu BusinessLine and India Today.
about.mission: To further the IIM Lucknow community's knowledge of financial markets, asset markets and personal finance through hands-on investment analysis.
about.vision: To remain the benchmark for student-run investing in India, known for disciplined research, a consistent track record and strong ties with the investment industry.

partner.title: Partner with Credence Capital
partner.lead: Reach a curated audience of finance-focused MBA students, faculty and alumni through events, competitions, research and digital channels — with packages built around your goals.
partner.audienceBody:
IIM Lucknow admits some of India's most selective MBA cohorts. Our fund managers come in with backgrounds at J.P. Morgan, TresVista, Deloitte and boutique hedge funds, and go on to summer internships at firms such as Avendus, Multiples PE, Bain & Co., McKinsey & Co., J.P. Morgan and SBICap Ventures.

Beyond the club, Nivesh, our Annual Investment Summit, reaches the wider IIM Lucknow student body, finance faculty and external participants. Investowise, our stock-pitch and industry-analysis competition, drew around 300 teams in 2021.
partner.customBody: Every package can be tailored. Sponsor a single flagship event, underwrite a competition prize pool, co-author a research report, or run a hiring-focused campus engagement. Tell us your objective and we will design around it.
partner.formBody: Share a few details and a member of our partnerships team will respond within two working days with a tailored proposal.

testimonials.quote: Members of Credence Capital apply their learning of financial and valuation concepts in their activities to benefit from market opportunities through intelligent risk taking. Not just trading, they are also involved in spreading their knowledge in IIM Lucknow community. They remain updated on what happens in the business world, set high targets and break them every time.

testimonials.quote: As an investment fund, it has brought smiles on the faces of its investors by delivering returns beyond their expectations. As a club, Credence has spread interest in finance, and trading in particular, among the students, building knowledge of finance and economic developments for students from diverse backgrounds.

faqs.question: Can we customise a sponsorship package?
faqs.answer: Yes. The tiers are starting points. Most partnerships are tailored around a specific objective such as hiring, brand awareness or product adoption.

faqs.question: How do payments and invoicing work?
faqs.answer: Contributions are processed through IIM Lucknow's official channels, and a formal invoice and receipt are issued. Our team will share details once the scope is agreed.

faqs.question: What will we receive after the event?
faqs.answer: Every partner receives a post-event report with reach, registrations, social impressions, photographs and participant feedback.

faqs.question: Can alumni or individuals contribute?
faqs.answer: Absolutely. Alumni and individuals can pledge towards any of our active fundraising campaigns, and we will reach out with next steps.
